description: root dir — The file rust_out (3.9 MB ELF executable, not stripped) is present in the workspace root and is not listed in .gitignore. Only /target/ is gitignored. Running 'git status' will show rust_out as an untracked file every session and it risks accidental commit. Add 'rust_out' (or '/rust_out') to .gitignore.
title: rust_out binary not in .gitignore
